turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm training for my first five kilometer race and I'm trying to pick a plan.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One plan has me running three days a week, slowly building up over about eight weeks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another one mixes running with cycling and swimming, so it's less hard on my knees.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a run walk method, where I alternate jogging and walking until I can run the whole thing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last is just running every day as far as I can and hoping for the best.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a first race, the three days a week plan is a classic for a reason, it gives your body time to recover. The run walk method is great if you're starting from zero. I'd skip running every day, that's a fast way to get hurt.
